relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, our findings demonstrated for the first time that SNI significantly downregulated CLCN7 expression in both SDH and DRG neurons.

relationships.subject: CLCN7
relationships.evidence_quote: Knockdown of CLCN7 via siRNA in the DRGs resulted in increased mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia in naïve mice.

relationships.subject: CLCN7
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings suggested that a deficiency in CLCN7 might enhance the excitability of small- and medium-sized DRG neurons and contribute to NP.

key_findings: CLCN7 is expressed mainly in dorsal horn and DRG neurons (co-expressed with CGRP and IB4 neurons) and is downregulated after spared nerve injury, mainly in small/medium DRG neurons.
CLCN7 siRNA knockdown in DRG caused mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia and increased excitability of cultured DRG neurons.
